nodes.label: Brainstorming HARD-GATE Rule
nodes.rationale: Prevents implementation skills, code, or scaffolding from being invoked until a design is presented and approved by the user, regardless of perceived project simplicity, because unexamined assumptions in 'simple' projects cause the most wasted work.

nodes.label: Visual Companion Just-in-Time Offer
nodes.rationale: Offered only when a question would genuinely be clearer shown than described, not upfront, to avoid token-intensive browser use when not needed.

nodes.label: Dispatch One Agent Per Independent Problem Domain
nodes.rationale: Multiple unrelated failures investigated sequentially wastes time; each independent investigation can run concurrently without shared state, preserving the coordinating session's own context.
nodes.norm_label: dispatch one agent per independent problem domain

nodes.label: Parallel Dispatch in Single Response Pattern
nodes.rationale: Multiple dispatch calls in one response execute in parallel; one dispatch per response executes sequentially and defeats the purpose.
nodes.norm_label: parallel dispatch in single response pattern

nodes.label: Preference for subagent-driven-development
nodes.rationale: Superpowers works much better with subagent support; quality of work is significantly higher when run on a platform with subagent support, so subagent-driven-development should be used instead when available.

nodes.label: Verify Tests Before Options Gate
nodes.rationale: Presenting merge/PR options before tests pass risks merging broken code or creating a failing PR; tests must pass before showing the 4 completion options.

nodes.label: Worktree Cleanup Provenance Check
nodes.rationale: Only worktrees under .worktrees/ or worktrees/ that Superpowers created should be removed; removing a harness-owned worktree causes phantom state, so cleanup only proceeds for Options 1 and 4 and only on self-created paths.

nodes.label: Fast Path for Existing Graph
nodes.rationale: If graphify-out/graph.json already exists and the request is a natural-language question (not an explicit rebuild command), skip extraction Steps 1-5 entirely and query directly, because the graph is already built and re-extraction would be wasteful.

nodes.label: Parallel AST + Semantic Extraction Rule
nodes.rationale: Parallelizing AST and semantic extraction saves 5-15s on large corpora; AST is deterministic and fast so it should start while subagents process docs/papers, since both operate on different file types and can run simultaneously.

nodes.label: No Other API Keys Read Rule
nodes.rationale: graphify does not read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, or any other provider key from the environment; if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY are unset it falls straight through to Claude Code subagent dispatch using the host session itself as the LLM.
nodes.norm_label: no other api keys read rule

nodes.label: Step B2: Dispatch All Subagents in Single Message
nodes.rationale: Calling the Agent tool multiple times in the same response is the only way subagents run in parallel; sequential calls (call, wait, call again) defeat the purpose. Must use subagent_type=general-purpose, not Explore, because Explore is read-only and cannot write chunk files to disk, silently dropping extraction results.

nodes.label: Shrink-Guard (#479) for graph.json
nodes.rationale: to_json() returns False (writing nothing) when the new graph is smaller than the existing graph.json, so GRAPH_REPORT.md and the analysis sidecar are only written when the graph was actually written, preventing them from describing a graph that graph.json doesn't contain (#1392).

nodes.label: Empty Graph Guard
nodes.rationale: An empty extraction must not clobber a good graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md/analysis sidecar; the guard runs immediately after build (#1392), before any write, and raises SystemExit if G.number_of_nodes() == 0.

nodes.norm_label: step 9: save manifest, update cost tracker, clean up, report

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS if unsure), never skip the corpus check warning, always show token cost in the report, never hide cohesion scores, never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning - maintains an honest audit trail.

nodes.label: Watch Debounce Rationale
nodes.rationale: Debounce (default 3s) waits until file activity stops before triggering, so a wave of parallel agent writes doesn't trigger a rebuild per file.

nodes.label: Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; the bimodal distribution observed in production (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) shows the range guidance was being collapsed to a binary, so discrete fixed values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) replace a continuous 0.6-0.95 range to force genuine calibration.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rule
nodes.rationale: The node ID must match the ID the AST extractor generates (stem_entity using one level of parent dir) so semantic and structural extraction merge into the same node instead of creating orphan ghost-duplicate nodes; using just the filename or the full path breaks this match.

nodes.label: source_file Verbatim Path Rule
nodes.rationale: source_file must be copied character-for-character from FILE_LIST, not shortened or re-relativized, so the full build and incremental --update stay on the same base and build_merge's replace-on-re-extract matches the existing node instead of accumulating a duplicate.

nodes.label: GitHub Clone and Cross-Repo Merge Reference
nodes.norm_label: github clone and cross-repo merge reference

nodes.label: Monorepo Output Directory Clobber Rationale
nodes.rationale: Running the skill pipeline on each subfolder separately would clobber the same graphify-out/ output dir in cwd; the CLI directly placing graphify-out/ inside each scanned subfolder avoids that, then merge-graphs combines them at the project root.

nodes.label: Commit Hook and CLAUDE.md Integration Reference
nodes.norm_label: commit hook and claude.md integration reference

nodes.label: Constrained Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: graphify's query CLI matches nodes via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming, no synonyms, no cross-language match, so if the user's question uses different vocabulary than the graph's labels the literal matcher returns 0 hits and collapses to noise; expanding the query against the graph's own vocabulary first (without inventing tokens) fixes this.

nodes.label: Work Memory Self-Improving Loop
nodes.rationale: Adding --outcome useful|dead_end|corrected lets future sessions learn from this one: useful nodes become preferred sources, dead_end paths are skipped next time, corrected records the right answer via --correction.

nodes.label: Whisper Domain-Hint Prompt Strategy
nodes.rationale: Read the god nodes/top labels from detection output to compose a one-sentence domain hint for the Whisper initial prompt, improving transcription accuracy for domain-specific terms, without needing a separate API call since the agent is already a language model.

nodes.label: JSON-via-Python-not-Shell-Redirect Guard
nodes.rationale: Writing the JSON from Python rather than a shell '>' redirect avoids corruption, since transcribe_all/Whisper print progress to stdout which would otherwise corrupt the JSON file (#1392).

nodes.label: Replace-on-Re-extract Mechanism (#1344)
nodes.rationale: prune_sources is only for genuinely deleted files; changed/re-extracted files are handled by build_merge's replace-on-re-extract, which drops every source_file present in new_chunks from the base before merging so stale nodes don't survive (#1344). Adding 'changed' files to prune_sources would delete the freshly re-extracted content, which #1178 made moot.

nodes.label: Edge Direction Preservation via build_merge (#801)
nodes.rationale: build_merge() reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction (calls, implements, imports) is always preserved (#801), and hyperedges from both the existing graph.json and the new extraction are combined rather than overwritten.

nodes.label: cluster-only Self-Contained Command
nodes.rationale: graphify cluster-only . is self-contained: it re-clusters, names communities, and regenerates GRAPH_REPORT.md/graph.json/graph.html from the existing graph; Steps 5-9 must not be re-run because they read intermediate files (.graphify_extract.json etc.) that a prior build's cleanup already deleted, raising FileNotFoundError (#1392).

nodes.label: ponytail-audit Scope Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Scope is over-engineering and complexity only; correctness bugs, security holes, and performance are explicitly out of scope and routed to a normal review pass instead, since ponytail-audit lists findings but applies nothing (one-shot).

nodes.label: ponytail: Comment Marker Convention
nodes.rationale: Every deliberate ponytail shortcut is marked with a 'ponytail: <ceiling>, <upgrade path>' comment naming its ceiling and upgrade path, so the ledger collects them and a deferral can't quietly become permanent ('later means never').

nodes.label: no-trigger Rot-Risk Flag
nodes.rationale: Any ponytail: comment that names no upgrade path or trigger gets a no-trigger tag, flagging the ones that silently rot since there is no defined point at which to revisit them.
